def corner_extras(Lt, Lb):
    # cell not in Lt&Lb, but Lt above & Lb right (and rotations)
    H,W = Lt.shape
    def shift(M, di, dj):
        out = np.zeros_like(M)
        i0 = max(0,di); i1 = H+min(0,di); j0 = max(0,dj); j1 = W+min(0,dj)
        out[i0:i1, j0:j1] = M[i0-di:i1-di, j0-dj:j1-dj]
        return out
    above_Lt = shift(Lt, 1, 0)   # Lt at (i-1,j)
